description: Find commitfest entries linked to a pgsql-hackers thread by Message-ID. (Returns empty until the mailing-list cross-reference scrape lands; the index attribute :entry/thread-message-id is in the schema.)

message_id.description: RFC822 Message-ID, with or without angle brackets, or a message URL (postgr.es/m/..., postgresql.org/message-id/..., pg.ddx.io/m/...)

name: find_entries_for_thread
